name: flow_storage
title: Flowpad data store
description: A data store on the Flowpad hub: your project's data files, kept on the hub and shared with the project's members. Datasets keep their rows here; offline, they keep them locally until the hub answers.

store_id.label: Data store
store_id.hint: The hub data store's id. Setup makes one for the project when it is empty.

prefix.label: Folder
prefix.hint: A folder inside the store; empty for the whole store.
